result.brief: 提出面向并行多模态离散扩散大模型的测试时扩展框架，在联合解码的思维-图像中间状态上做跨模态验证搜索，提升统一理解与生成模型的推理期选择效果。
result.reason: Parallel multimodal discrete diffusion LLM jointly decoding reasoning and image tokens; test-time search over thought-image states. Touches unified understanding/generation and continuous latent reasoning, though focus is inference-time scaling.
